## Problem

What problem would this feature solve? What's the motivation?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to happen. If it changes what the server owns (the catalog) or what the user owns (saves, tickets, bookmarks, follows), say which, and how a sync must treat it. If it involves time, say which zone each screen should show.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context

Mockups, links or references. If it relates to the [roadmap](../../docs/ROADMAP.md), mention where.
